cases.requirement: Identical evidence and policy produce the same sealed epoch digest and the same compile/minimize output.
An evaluator that rewrites declared Tier-1 evidence does not invalidate the already sealed current transaction.
A subsequent refreshed epoch includes the generated evidence and does not lose it.
Unexpected mutation of critical source/authority evidence fails closed even though immutable starting bytes exist.
Missing/corrupt content-addressed pinned evidence fails closed.
Contradictory authoritative start state cannot seal an epoch.
Prefix-preserving append-only growth is classified as next-epoch evidence; shrink/prefix mutation is unsafe.
Raw Gen8 and minimized Gen9 packets carry the exact same epoch ID/digest and evidence/Twin view.
Rebuilding live Twin after seal does not change active epoch output; the next epoch observes rebuilt Twin.
Gen7 retained benchmark stays 15/15 in a version-pinned epoch/capsule view without Gen8/Gen9/Gen10 evidence.
Half-created/incomplete epochs never become authoritative and are recovered without adopting partial state.
Concurrent reads of sealed epochs cannot produce a mixed-epoch packet.
Mutation-producing capsule tests cause zero forbidden accepted-state mutation.
Unrelated evidence produced elsewhere cannot perturb a sealed epoch output.
An authority declared live-revalidate-only cannot be sealed as safely pinned without a live verifier.

safety_invariants: No critical stale/missing/contradictory evidence is reclassified as safe merely because an epoch is pinned.
Expected outputs are queued for the next epoch only when the starting bytes are complete and verifiable.
Live-revalidation authorities cannot be satisfied by frozen bytes alone.
Historical gold/evidence is not rewritten to match current state.
